title: Anchors can be listed, created and changed over MCP
body:
Later, and the reason anchors exist in this form: Jack wants agents to be
able to set up and change the layout, on 2026-11-06. Tools on decade's MCP
server to list panes with their kind and rule, create an anchor with a name
and a rule by splitting a pane, change a rule, and remove an anchor. The
socket gets the same verbs for pane programs. Not exposed until the layout
model has settled.
